verdict.rationale: Restate documents durable execution logging of steps (inputs/outputs stored via ctx.run, retries, terminal errors) and an Introspection SQL API plus CLI for querying invocation and state data, which gives per-step visibility into runs. However, there is no explicit evidence of a searchable/filterable dashboard UI — only CLI and SQL-based introspection are documented, and a community comment even flags the lack of visual state-machine/execution diagrams compared to competitors. Missing for 10: dedicated dashboard UI screenshots/docs, explicit search/filter UI capability, independent confirmation of dashboard usability.
